meta.title: Toolset
meta.description: One plugin bundling several small features, each with its own switch, plus the PTC + Creator agent preset. Feature 1: a live request status line under the composer (ready / requesting / waiting for reply / thinking / waiting for tools / writing / error). Feature 2: the dsh_safe_restart tool, which restarts DeepSeek Harness after agents and jobs are idle and then resumes the session automatically. Feature 3: a rewind action beside Copy on every user message. Feature 4: system-prompt tuning that starts from an existing Agent preset, edits its opening identity line and initial system prompt, and saves the result as a new preset. Feature 5: the ask_model tool, which asks a configured local or cloud chat model (with file, image, audio and video attachments) — a plain chat, not an Agent. Preset: PTC + Creator merges runtime self-inspection and dynamic plugin mounting with PTC programmatic tool calling through run_code.
